title: The Astoria Roof job and Fate Marable's offer
summary: At the Astoria Roof he played in David Jones's band until Fate Marable heard him and invited him onto the boat, despite his not reading music.

story.theme_name: Dance halls, lake camps and riverboat bandstands
story.community_name: Working the Streckfus riverboats with Fate Marable

blocks.x: Oh, so do I get in? I'll turn it off for a second. Can you mind me a little bit more about that job at the Astoria Hotel, or what do they call it, the ballroom, really?

Yes, it was the Astoria Roof. Roof. Oh, it was on the roof, though. Yeah, well no, that's what they call it, Astoria Roof, yeah. David Jones developed a very fine band up there. It's one of the trombone players of Celestan's A, Tuxedo, probably the trombone, Bay, Bay, yeah. Yeah, that's the guy. And we had a nice little band for a long time up there. And then, and I stayed with him, and almost was about to learn to play that bass horn pretty fair. Yeah. Well, the big thing that happened to me, and started me on my real music career, right out of that Astoria Roof, Fait Myable stepped in then. He saw me, he saw me, so I never forget, so one night he come down and said, sit.

The kid said, I heard a lot of talk of you. I had to come down and look you over. I can see now what the people on there. He said, I'd like to take you on the boat with me. I told him, I said, well, I don't read. He said, well, that's all right. Many of them from here, everyone I've taken from here I couldn't read. But you will if you stick with me a long time. I said, well, I don't know. I'll try. So he'd come back again in the afternoon. So I made up my mind to go with him. About what year was that? Oh, that was in the early, the late 20th. The late 20th.
